content.text:
**Recommend an explicit optional native received-zero-boundary patch, followed by a source-origin-aware Mosaic adapter change.** The evidence supports two separate defects; allowing zero alone will not guarantee forwarding order, and routing Mosaic through the current adapter alone would preserve the native 25 ms error.

- **Native defect:** candidate07’s [clock_midi.c:85](/home/andy/projects/monome-runtime-candidates/midi-clock-boundary-07/norns/matron/src/clocks/clock_midi.c:85) correctly suppresses interpolation before acquisition. But [clock_scheduler.c:110](/home/andy/projects/monome-runtime-candidates/midi-clock-boundary-07/norns/matron/src/clocks/clock_scheduler.c:110) requires `clock_beat > event->sync_clock_beat`, while reset assigns deadline zero. The generic, Mosaic-free manifests independently record first-F8 offsets of [25 ms controlled](/home/andy/projects/monome-emulator-midi-clock/artifacts/midi-clock/3a7a3b924a624fad8345ed95a9e86da8/manifest.json:5) and [25.486193 ms real-time](/home/andy/projects/monome-emulator-midi-clock/artifacts/midi-clock/d6fd1ed3e0464679923b843883d8a986/manifest.json:5).
- **Application defect:** [m_clock.lua:844](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/lib/clock/m_clock.lua:844) explicitly excludes external Start from boundary coordination. Commit `1d68914` introduced that exclusion. All four recorded forwarding cases fail with receiver state `(0, -1, True)`; the cold [capture:180](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-runs/99bc86182d1f4923a804e9d99eff87be/results.json:180) confirms NoteOn at `4105000000`, followed by F8 at `4130000000` and `4130000001`. The source-anchored note/gate assertion executes **before** the failing receiver assertion ([forwarded_clock.py:33](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/tests/behaviour/forwarded_clock.py:33)).

The bounded correction should be:

1. **Recognize a received boundary independently of tempo acquisition.** On the first F8 following FA, publish source beat zero with its epoch and receipt timestamp, and allow the core output waiter to consume that boundary exactly once. FA alone must not manufacture F8. Keep beat interpolation frozen until a valid interval exists; advance the consumed output deadline to `1/24`, preventing zero from being replayed at clock two. Prefer a narrowly tagged output-boundary exception over changing every `clock.sync` comparison to `>=`.

2. **Make source-start publication and scheduler visibility one transaction.** Currently [clock.c:118](/home/andy/projects/monome-runtime-candidates/midi-clock-boundary-07/norns/matron/src/clock.c:118) resets, then posts Start; reset has already unlocked at [clock_scheduler.c:313](/home/andy/projects/monome-runtime-candidates/midi-clock-boundary-07/norns/matron/src/clocks/clock_scheduler.c:313). Queue the epoch-bearing Start before exposing its boundary resumes, with consistent synchronization around source-reference publication too. Preserve queued-resume claims and stale-epoch rejection. Do not execute Lua callbacks under that lock.

3. **Use the boundary adapter for incoming Start when forwarding is enabled.** Supply the known source origin—zero in the new Start epoch—not the first callback’s observed time or an arbitrarily late output deadline. The current [adapter:56](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/lib/clock/midi_output_transport.lua:56) adopts its first deadline as origin. Preserve permanent after-F8 ownership of coincident pulses and single ownership of intermediates. The existing generic [dispatch:248](/home/andy/projects/monome-runtime-candidates/midi-clock-boundary-07/norns/lua/core/clock.lua:248) already provides before → all selected F8 outputs → after.

The regression contract must cover cold and warm acquisition, repeated Start, queued Start/Stop/Start, cancellation before delivery, direct init/reset, subscriber faults, and source handoff in both modes. Repeated external Start resets receiver phase with cleanup but no echoed Stop; source handoff without Start preserves receiver progression and rejects obsolete work. Require FA before first F8 before NoteOn, receiver ticks `0,6,12…`, exactly 24 F8 per quarter, unchanged absolute note/gate deadlines, and no F8 on disabled/input-only ports. Include later gates, intermediate subdivisions, wraps, tempo changes, and delayed dispatch—not merely startup.

Exact-input-clock forwarding is a valid **separate explicit mode** if literal input-edge tracking is required: it must exclusively own F8 while selected, suppress interpolated duplicates, and retain generic fanout callbacks. It is broader than the minimal repair and unnecessary to establish the current constant-tempo contract.

Before clock two, an unknown fractional interval cannot be scheduled accurately without prediction; catch-up cannot recover elapsed wall time. **The already-received zero boundary is known**, so its missing F8 is a real bug. Retain strict legacy parity ([native_scheduler_step.c:45](/home/andy/projects/monome-emulator-midi-clock/tests/native_scheduler_step.c:45)) and negative baselines; record the exception as an optional upstream patch, never a silent emulator adjustment.

**CONFIDENCE: High** on diagnosis; the proposed correction remains unverified without implementation and D/R regressions. No runs were performed; the full goal remains incomplete.
